_comment: One fixed look for every video. Set `active` (or VISUAL_STYLE in .env) to the preset that matches your character: a 3D character needs a 3D-looking backdrop.

stylised_3d.suffix: stylised 3D render, soft studio lighting, clean shapes, rich teal and amber palette, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, no text, no watermarks

anime.suffix: anime illustration, cel shaded, bold clean line art, cinematic lighting, deep blue and magenta palette, vertical 9:16, no text, no watermarks

cyberpunk.suffix: cinematic dark futuristic tech illustration, anime cyberpunk aesthetic, vertical 9:16, 8k high quality, no text, no watermarks

host_zone._comment: Area kept clear in every image for the on-screen host. Pixels on the 1080x1920 frame.
host_zone.composition_prompt: main subject in the upper right, empty uncluttered lower left corner
